title: Take the waters at Buckstaff Bathhouse
description: Step into Buckstaff Bathhouse on Hot Springs’ historic Bathhouse Row and follow a bathing routine that has welcomed visitors for more than a century. Warm thermal water, a wrap, and time to rest make the visit feel deliberately unhurried. The building and ritual together offer a close encounter with an older American way of taking a break.
teaser: Spend an unhurried afternoon on historic Bathhouse Row.
goodToKnow: Before you go, check treatment suitability, transfers, stairs and comfort with the bathing format.
whyItMightDelightYou: The sequence of bathing and resting gives you permission to slow your day down completely.
